permissions.action: Make issues
permissions.why: Issues are material: what a session reads and weighs, not orders it must follow.

chat.note: Unstarted and unassigned

untrusted.note: Only as a proposal labelled external

permissions.action: Change an issue: its status, assignee, priority, milestone, release
permissions.why: Only one session works an issue at a time, and a proposal is work only once the owner approves it.

session.note: Not an issue another session is on, nor a proposal’s status, assignee or release before it’s approved

chat.note: What it says and where it sits; its status and assignee only on your Allow, and not a proposal’s before it’s approved

member.note: On their boards, within what a session may

permissions.action: Claim an issue, let it go or take it over
permissions.why: Whoever holds an issue says so, and only the owner takes one from someone else.

session.note: Only what’s assigned to its person, with more than one person

member.note: Their own, or one unassigned, on their boards

permissions.action: Rate how risky an issue’s pull request is
permissions.why: The session that opened a PR knows what it changes, so it says where reviewing should start; your own rating stands.

session.note: Not over a rating you set yourself

member.note: On their boards, not over a rating you set yourself

permissions.action: Remove issues, milestones, releases or docs
permissions.why: Taking away what the owner made is their call.

session.note: Not what the owner made

member.note: On their boards, not what the owner made

permissions.action: Approve, reject or ask for changes to a proposal
permissions.why: A proposal asks the owner; deciding it is their answer.

permissions.action: Comment, and ask the owner a question
permissions.why: Comments are how a session tells the owner what it did, and asks.

session.note: Not editing or deleting the owner’s comments

untrusted.note: Only on its own external proposals

permissions.action: Write and change docs and releases
permissions.why: Docs are material, kept current by the sessions that read them.

chat.note: Docs, never a section renamed or deleted, nor a doc removed; a release only on your Allow

permissions.action: Make and change milestones
permissions.why: A milestone groups issues: material, like the issues in it.

chat.note: When you ask in it (ORR-988)

permissions.action: Make and change epics
permissions.why: An epic is one piece of work across projects (ORR-895): material, like the milestones each project has.

chat.note: When you ask in it (ORR-988)

permissions.action: Comment on epics
permissions.why: An epic is the whole orrery’s, not a board’s (ORR-977): comments on it are held as the epic is.

session.note: Not editing or deleting the owner’s comments

chat.note: Adding one, not editing or deleting any

permissions.action: Remove epics
permissions.why: Its issues stay where they are; taking away what the owner made is their call.

session.note: Not one the owner made

permissions.action: Write presets
permissions.why: A preset’s text is an order every later session gets in the owner’s voice: one session writing it would write the orders for the rest.

permissions.action: Change the focus prompts and standing instructions
permissions.why: The same: what sessions are told must do is the owner’s to write.

session.note: A project’s other fields are free

member.note: A board’s other fields, on their boards

permissions.action: Change App settings and the statuses
permissions.why: They change how orrery runs for every project and session.

chat.note: One setting at a time, saved on your Allow

permissions.action: Ask sessions to focus on an issue, a milestone or an epic
permissions.why: Only the owner points sessions at work, so a session can’t set others going.

session.note: An agent’s focus is kept, and no session hears it

member.note: On their boards, as a session’s focus: no session hears it

permissions.action: Message a session, or every session
permissions.why: A message reaches a session as the owner’s words.

chat.note: Sent as yours on your Send

permissions.action: Start, stop or give more time to a session
permissions.why: Starting work, or ending it, is the owner’s.

chat.note: Done as yours on your Allow; a session for work on an issue it starts itself, through its chat

member.note: Stop or give more time to their own, never their agents; starting one stays the owner’s

permissions.action: Connect a repo: open a folder picker on a launcher’s machine
permissions.why: It opens a window on your machine, and writes to the folder you choose there.

permissions.action: Watch a session in a terminal
permissions.why: It opens a window on your machine.

permissions.action: Allow or deny what a session asks permission for
permissions.why: A permission prompt is there for a person to answer, not another session.

permissions.action: Answer in a chat, and ask the owner there
permissions.why: A chat is between the owner and its own session.

chat.note: Only in its own chat

permissions.action: Chat with an agent: start, write in, clear, end or delete a chat, and answer what it asks
permissions.why: The chat is the owner talking to an agent, and its requests wait on their answer.

chat.note: It answers in its chat and asks there, never answering for you

permissions.action: Make a schedule that makes issues
permissions.why: An issue is material, so a schedule making them is too.

session.note: It runs, but its asks reach no session

chat.note: Saved as yours on your Allow

member.note: On their boards, and its asks reach no session

permissions.action: Make a schedule that messages sessions
permissions.why: Its message would reach sessions as the owner’s words.

session.note: Saved, but each run is skipped until you read it and press Make it mine

chat.note: Saved as yours on your Allow

permissions.action: Make a schedule that starts sessions
permissions.why: It starts work as the owner.

session.note: It asks you on its issue instead

chat.note: Saved as yours on your Allow

permissions.action: Make a schedule that moves issues
permissions.why: It moves issues as the owner, with no session.

session.note: It asks you on its issue instead

chat.note: Saved as yours on your Allow

permissions.action: Make, change or delete a schedule across projects
permissions.why: It runs as the owner on every project it names, and on ones added later.

permissions.action: Make an agent’s schedule the owner’s (Make it mine)
permissions.why: From then on its words reach sessions as the owner’s, so the owner reads them first: changing it, a pause or a rename, doesn’t make it theirs.

permissions.action: Change, run or delete one of the owner’s schedules
permissions.why: What the owner set running stays as they set it.

session.note: A schedule an agent made stays free to change

chat.note: A change or a pause, saved on your Allow; deleting stays on Schedules

member.note: One an agent made, on their boards

permissions.action: Pause or activate all of a project’s schedules
permissions.why: Activating all also turns on what was paused on purpose, so it’s the owner’s to do, on Schedules.

permissions.action: Ask the owner, on the issue it’s working, to make or change a schedule
permissions.why: What a schedule says reaches sessions as the owner’s words, so the owner reads it before it runs (ORR-458).

session.note: A comment with Allow and Deny, waiting on your decision; saved as yours on your Allow

chat.note: It asks in its chat instead

permissions.action: Allow or deny a session’s request for a schedule
permissions.why: Allowing saves the schedule as the owner’s, so only they can.

permissions.action: Add, rename, remove or invite a person
permissions.why: Who works on this orrery is the owner’s to decide.

permissions.action: Make or revoke a key
permissions.why: A key can’t make or widen a key, so an agent can never become its person. A person handles their own, and the owner issues them to others.

session.note: a person, logged in: never a session, whatever key it has

member.note: Their own: the route refuses their agents, and anyone else's key

permissions.action: Count a use of a feature
permissions.why: How often each feature is used, for App settings’ Usage (ORR-881), so what goes unused can go. Only the owner’s own use is counted, and only once they turn counting on; anyone else’s is taken and ignored.

session.note: The tools it calls, counted for the owner’s own sessions alone

chat.note: The tools it calls

member.note: Taken, and not counted: only the owner’s use is

permissions.action: End a browser’s login
permissions.why: A login is a browser signed in, a phone’s too (ORR-838), so a person ends their own, the owner anyone’s, from App settings: how a lost phone is shut out. Never a session, which has no login and no business with them.

permissions.action: Log in or out
permissions.why: Nobody has a credential until they’ve logged in, and a session has no use for a login: an agent key signs nothing in.

permissions.action: Make a sign-in link for a phone
permissions.why: The link signs a phone in as the owner (ORR-837), so only the owner’s own page on this machine makes one, never a session, which would get a login it must never have.

permissions.action: Set, change or delete a secret
permissions.why: A secret’s value and where it may go are the owner’s to decide.

permissions.action: Call an outside service with a secret (egress)
permissions.why: orrery fills the secret in, so a session uses a key without ever seeing it.

session.note: Only to the hosts and projects the secret allows

chat.note: Only to the hosts and projects the secret allows

permissions.action: Back up, restore or move the database
permissions.why: It decides where all of orrery’s data is.

session.note: And only from this machine

permissions.action: See the repos’ branches, and remove one
permissions.why: A branch’s name can hold anyone’s words, and removing one can’t be undone from here.

permissions.action: Poll GitHub for pull requests now
permissions.why: Each poll spends GitHub’s requests, which are few without a token.

permissions.action: Clear the bell or mark it read, or forget a session
permissions.why: What waits on the owner goes when they say.

member.note: Their own bell, never their agents

permissions.action: Give or change the owner’s name
permissions.why: The first to open orrery names its owner; after that, it’s theirs.

session.note: Only before the owner has a name

permissions.action: Make a project
permissions.why: A new board belongs to whoever made it, and nobody else is on it until they say.

permissions.action: Upload a board's file as a new board
permissions.why: A file is untrusted, and a person chooses to bring one in. It never overwrites a board, and nothing in it speaks for anyone.

permissions.action: Delete a project
permissions.why: It takes everything on the board with it.

session.note: Not one holding what the owner made

member.note: The board’s holder, and their agents

permissions.action: Add or remove a board’s members
permissions.why: Holding a board means saying who’s on it, and agents can’t let themselves in.

member.note: The board’s holder, never their agents

permissions.action: Import issues into a project
permissions.why: What comes in is material, as an issue a session makes is.

permissions.action: Upload an image
permissions.why: An image is only shown where something links to it.

permissions.action: Say what a session is doing, from its hook, channel or launcher
permissions.why: It’s a session reporting on itself, which changes nothing on the roadmap.

permissions.action: Report an error to the event log
permissions.why: Anyone’s page or session can say something went wrong; it’s kept as a report.

permissions.action: Mark an event dealt with
permissions.why: The log covers every board, so it stays with the owner and their agents.

session.note: It keeps their name, and the bell still shows it until the owner looks

chat.note: It keeps their name, and the bell still shows it until the owner looks
